objective: Implement a local, deterministic TORC P0 vertical slice proving append-only lineage, target-fit projection, acceptance-gated handoff, exclusive authority transfer, and provenance verification between two synthetic execution substrates.
success_evidence: The full automated test suite passes on the implementation host.
A local demo completes one accepted handoff and exports inspectable artifacts.
A rejected handoff leaves source authority unchanged.
Duplicate authoritative lease acquisition fails transactionally.
Tampering with immutable lineage or handoff artifacts is detected by verification.
Different projections do not mutate the canonical source revision.
non_goals: A daemon, web service, watcher, scheduler, or background worker.
Replacement of Autowork, Sulis, agent-continuity, Omniroute, Bran, agent-mail, lugos-mcp, or HUD surfaces.
Automatic lineage merge or learned fit scoring.
Edits to the parent Lugos repository or its submodule pointer.
accepted_threats: The local single-operator prototype does not defend against a malicious process with direct filesystem access.
SHA-256 supplies tamper evidence but not authentication or confidentiality.
Synthetic substrate descriptors do not prove continuity across real frontier models.
A deterministic word or character budget only approximates provider tokenization.
